fxSettlement.value: Net settlement surplus $48.5B (Aug) · cross-border net inflow $62.4B (+4% MoM) · non-bank cross-border receipts+payments $1.5T
fxSettlement.value_zh: 8月净结汇顺差$485亿 · 跨境资金净流入$624亿（环比+4%）· 非银跨境收付$1.5万亿
fxSettlement.note: NEW (checked 2026-10-11): no new SAFE monthly release (September data due ~mid-Oct); August figures stand. Yuan strength corroborated: USD/CNY 6.6926 (Oct 9), +6.36% YoY. SAFE data released Sep 15: commercial banks posted a net FX settlement-and-sales surplus of $48.5 BILLION in August; cross-border capital recorded a net inflow of $62.4B, up 4% month on month; non-bank (enterprises + individuals) cross-border receipts and payments totaled $1.5T; FX market trading value $3.9T. SAFE's Li Bin attributed the net inflow mainly to large goods-trade receipts, with a wider services deficit from summer travel; two-way direct investment stable. In early September the yuan hit a four-year high as export regions (Guangdong/Zhejiang/Jiangsu + Shenzhen/Ningbo) drew $87.23B net inflows. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-20): July 2026 (SAFE, Aug 17): settlement -> net surplus ¥124.1B; Jan-Jul net surplus ¥1,997.2B; H1 settlement+sales $2.9T (+24% YoY, record). Updated 2026-09-27.
fxSettlement.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-27）：8月确认顺差——Jev闸门通过（has_new_data 0.89、source_quality 1.97）。外管局9月15日发布：8月银行结售汇净顺差$485亿；跨境资金净流入$624亿、环比+4%；非银（企业+个人）跨境收付合计$1.5万亿；外汇市场成交$3.9万亿。外管局李斌称净流入主要来自货物贸易大额流入，暑期出境游扩大服务贸易逆差；双向直接投资基本稳定。9月初人民币创四年新高，出口大省（粤/浙/苏+深圳/宁波）净流入$872.3亿。前情（核查于2026-09-20）：2026年7月（外管局8月17日）：净结汇顺差¥1,241亿；1-7月净顺差¥1.9972万亿；上半年结售汇$2.9万亿（同比+24%，创纪录）。更新于 2026-09-27。

chinaEvExports.value: 1.053M vehicles exported (Sep, CAAM, +61.4% YoY, +4.2% MoM) · NEV exports 571K (+160% YoY, +8.6% MoM) = >50% of exports 4th straight month · Jan-Sep exports 8.205M (+65.8%), incl. >4M NEVs · CAAM sees 2026 exports >10M
chinaEvExports.value_zh: 9月出口汽车105.3万辆（中汽协，同比+61.4%、环比+4.2%）· 新能源出口57.1万辆（+160%，环比+8.6%）——连续第4个月占出口过半 · 1-9月出口820.5万辆（+65.8%），其中新能源超400万辆 · 中汽协预计2026年出口超1000万辆

chinaEvExports.threshold_zh: 关注比亚迪+上汽中东/东南亚出货量
chinaEvExports.note: NEW (checked 2026-10-18): SEPTEMBER CAAM DATA ADOPTED — Jev gate PASSED (has_new_data 0.86, source_quality 1.76). CAAM (released Oct 12): September vehicle exports 1.053M (+61.4% YoY, +4.2% MoM); NEV exports 571K (+160% YoY, +8.6% MoM) — NEVs >50% of exports for a 4th straight month. Jan-Sep exports 8.205M (+65.8%), incl. >4M NEVs (more than double YoY). CAAM expects 2026 total exports to exceed 10M units. CPCA per AP (Oct 12): passenger-car exports +64% YoY. Domestic mirror: September NEV sales 1.823M (+13.6%), NEV share of new-car sales record 61.6%, but domestic NEV sales -9.4% — export wedge keeps widening. EU trade chief Sefcovic: China-EU interim deal could CUT Chinese hybrid exports by ~half — trade-defence tightening. PRIOR (checked 2026-10-11): no new CAAM/CPCA September total yet; value held. Company-level September prints (SMM/CPCA, Oct): Chery overseas sales 207.8K (+45.6% YoY, record), BYD 180.7K (+154%), Geely 106.7K (+162%, 4th straight month >100K; full-year 1M target announced); GWM overseas >50% of volume. CPCA September passenger retail ~1.69M (-24.6% YoY), NEV retail ~1.11M (+10% MoM) — retail down ~29% YoY Sep 1-27 while NEV wholesale +7% YTD: the export wedge widens. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-27): no new export print; CPCA guidance September NEV retail ~1.11M, penetration 70.3% early month. NEW (checked 2026-09-20): AUGUST SET RECORDS AND CROSSED THE 2025 FULL-YEAR TOTAL. CAAM (released ~Sep 10): total vehicle exports 1.01M in August, +65.3% YoY — above 1M for a THIRD consecutive month; NEV exports 526K, up ~130% YoY and ~52.1% of total vehicle exports (above half for a third straight month); Jan-Aug NEV exports 3.435M (+124.3%) against total vehicle exports 7.153M (+66.7%). CPCA (Sep 8-9): passenger-car exports 888K (+77.8% YoY, -4.2% MoM) = 38% of automakers' total sales; passenger NEV exports 518K (+154.7%) = 58.4% of passenger exports, up 18pp YoY; BEVs 63.4% of NEV exports, PHEVs 32.9%, EREVs 3.7%. Top NEV exporters: BYD 183,746 (+130.8%, 35.4% share), Geely 69,910 (+440.2%), Chery 68,431 (+221.2%), Tesla China 36,119 (+38.7% YoY but -45.5% MoM, share down to 7.0% from 12.3%), Changan 28,323. Jan-Aug BYD 1,126,797 NEVs exported (+87.5%, 33.9% of market). Group totals: Chery 196,984 exports (+52.1%, 70.3% of its volume — first Chinese automaker past 7.18M cumulative exports); BYD 189,500 (record, 43% of group sales); Geely 110,094 (+205%, NEVs 70,600 = +446%); GWM 62,517. Electrek (Sep 10): China exported 6.2M passenger vehicles through August — already more than all of 2025 (6.1M) with four months to go; full-year track ~9-10M. Domestic mirror-image: CAAM total NEV sales +17.8% to 1.643M, a record 60.6% of all new vehicle sales, but DOMESTIC NEV sales fell 4.6% (domestic passenger NEV -8.2%); narrow passenger retail ~1.58M, down 20%+ YoY; NEV retail penetration 65.8%; wholesale is running ~2.7M units above retail YTD — the export/inventory wedge. Trade defence closing in: the EU extended countervailing duties to PHEVs in late August; Turkey, Brazil and Indonesia raised local-content/tariff walls. Strategic answer from all four majors: shift from shipping to overseas assembly (BYD Hungary/Brazil, Chery Spain/Indonesia, Geely footprint) — ramping through 2027. Updated 2026-09-27
chinaEvExports.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-10-18）：中汽协9月数据采信——Jev闸门通过（has_new_data 0.86、source_quality 1.76）。中汽协（10月12日发布）：9月汽车出口105.3万辆（同比+61.4%、环比+4.2%）；新能源出口57.1万辆（+160%，环比+8.6%）——连续第4个月占出口过半。1-9月出口820.5万辆（+65.8%），其中新能源超400万辆（同比翻倍以上）。中汽协预计2026年总出口超1000万辆。乘联会经美联社（10月12日）：乘用车出口同比+64%。国内镜像：9月新能源销量182.3万辆（+13.6%），新能源占新车销量创纪录61.6%，但国内新能源销量-9.4%——出口楔形继续扩大。欧盟贸易专员谢夫乔维奇：中欧临时协议或使中国混动出口削减约一半——贸易防御收紧。 前情（核查于2026-10-11）：中汽协/乘联会9月总量尚未发布（约10月10-15日）；数值保持。9月公司层面数据（SMM/乘联会，10月）：奇瑞海外销量20.78万辆（同比+45.6%，创新高）、比亚迪18.07万（+154%）、吉利10.67万（+162%，连续4个月破10万；宣布全年100万海外目标）；长城海外占其销量过半。乘联会9月乘用车零售约169万辆（同比-24.6%），新能源零售约111万（环比+10%）——9月1-27日零售同比约-29%而新能源批发年内+7%：出口/内销楔形继续扩大。 前情（核查于2026-09-27）：本周无新中汽协/乘联会出口数据——9月数据约10月初发布。乘联会指引：9月新能源零售约111万辆；9月前13天新能源零售渗透率70.3%。 新（核查于2026-09-13）：8月创多项纪录，并已超越2025年全年出口总量。中汽协（约9月10日发布）：8月汽车出口101万辆，同比+65.3%——连续第三个月超过100万辆；新能源出口52.6万辆，同比+约130%，占汽车出口约52.1%（连续第三个月过半）；1-8月新能源出口343.5万辆（+124.3%），汽车出口合计715.3万辆（+66.7%）。乘联会（9月8-9日）：乘用车出口88.8万辆（同比+77.8%，环比-4.2%），占车企总销量38%；乘用车新能源出口51.8万辆（+154.7%），占乘用车出口58.4%，同比提升18个百分点；纯电占新能源出口63.4%、插混32.9%、增程3.7%。新能源出口前五：比亚迪183,746辆（+130.8%，份额35.4%）、吉利69,910辆（+440.2%）、奇瑞68,431辆（+221.2%）、特斯拉中国36,119辆（同比+38.7%但环比-45.5%，份额从12.3%降至7.0%）、长安28,323辆。1-8月比亚迪累计出口新能源1,126,797辆（+87.5%，占市场33.9%）。集团口径：奇瑞出口196,984辆（+52.1%，占其销量70.3%——首家累计出口突破718万辆的中国车企）；比亚迪189,500辆（创纪录，占集团销量43%）；吉利110,094辆（+205%，其中新能源70,600辆=+446%）；长城62,517辆。Electrek（9月10日）：中国1-8月出口乘用车620万辆——已超过2025年全年（610万辆），尚有四个月；全年有望达900-1000万辆。国内镜像：中汽协新能源总销量+17.8%至164.3万辆，占全部新车销量创纪录的60.6%，但国内新能源销量下降4.6%（国内乘用车新能源-8.2%）；狭义乘用车零售约158万辆，同比降20%以上；新能源零售渗透率65.8%；年内批发较零售高出约270万辆——出口/库存楔形。贸易防御收紧：欧盟8月底将反补贴关税扩至插电混动；土耳其、巴西、印尼提高本地含量/关税门槛。四大出口车企的战略回应一致：从整车发运转向海外组装（比亚迪匈牙利/巴西、奇瑞西班牙/印尼、吉利海外布局）——2027年前逐步放量。更新于 2026-09-27
